baseline: Current cleaned study27-combat from PR11 (origin e72cec8; exact six-file pins in baseline/manifest.json), not the earlier unmodified study27.
purpose: Implement connected farming/banking decisions and measure their mechanisms and combined performance. Isolated wins are NOT a prerequisite for testing coherent combinations.

references.limits: Style probes are predeclared alternative policies, not claims of strength or contemporary top-team opponents. Also report older-spar and new-style subsets separately.

development.screen: All 13 packages on official9 + gen44 =53 maps, both sides versus current baseline and all five fixed references.
development.full: These four coherent packages advance regardless isolated or screen win rate, unless a correctness/fault blocker makes their results invalid. Also advance at most one other screen candidate, ranked by matched five-reference win delta then submitted-gem delta. Full cohort is official9 + gen44 + dev200 =253 maps, both sides/all six opponents; reuse exact games once.
development.selection: After full runs, prefer positive matched five-reference win score and direct baseline score >=50%, no individual reference regression >3 percentage points and zero reported faults/reinitializations on either side. Rank panel delta, then matched submitted-gem delta, then fewer features. Development significance is descriptive after adaptive selection.
development.transfer: Before final freeze, run the leading full candidate on 128 previously exposed combat-confirmation maps, both sides/all six opponents with a matched baseline panel. This is exposed development evidence. If transfer has a nonpositive panel delta or direct baseline score <50%, permit the next full-ranked candidate a transfer check, at most two candidates total. No tuning from final holdout.
development.mechanisms: Check branch activity; submitted/collected gems and deposit ratio, spent gold, deaths, monster damage dealt/taken, and rates per 100 rounds. Lower incoming camp damage without maintaining productivity is not itself an improvement. Geometry strata and actual drafts are descriptive. Telemetry maxima are sampled lower bounds; death-after-camp is an observational proxy, not death attribution.

quality: Full SDK compilation and meaningful helper/source checks before games. Include either team's reported faults/reinitializations. Low-fuel/caught API samples are diagnostics. Runtime, ordered WASMs, maps and statistics are pinned/deduplicated; cache reuse is never new evidence.

confirmation.generator: Existing native map generator at work/study28-fixes/generate-fresh.mjs, tools pinned before generating. Generate only after one final source/WASM freeze; ensure unique native geometries and no byte overlap with all exposed maps.
confirmation.games: Candidate vs current baseline and five fixed references; baseline vs five references; both sides =22 games/map, 11264 total.
confirmation.pass: Positive direct baseline score with exact two-sided paired-map both-won vs both-lost sign p<0.05; positive matched five-reference mean and positive vs negative per-map panel deltas with two-sided sign p<0.05; no reference regression >2 percentage points; zero all-side reported faults/reinitializations.
confirmation.policy: One fixed complete fresh cohort; no tuning, early stopping or candidate swapping based on its outcomes. If gates fail, do not claim a validated stronger submission. Preserve implemented code and honest diagnostics for further development.
confirmation.limits: One procedural distribution and fixed local opponents cannot establish superiority on the current online ladder or every unseen tournament map.
